question: Let \(a\) be a non-zero complex number such that \(|a|\ne1\). Let \(P\) be the point \(a\) in the complex plane, and let \(Q\) be the point \(1/\bar a\). Let \(C_1\) be the circle \(\{z:|z|=1\}\) and let \(C_2\) be any circle passing through \(P\) and \(Q\). Show that \(C_1\) and \(C_2\) intersect orthogonally. [Two circles are said to intersect orthogonally if the tangents at a point of intersection are perpendicular to each other.]
